summary: The run passed. The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development first and set up a `ratelimit` branch. It then implemented and reviewed all six tasks one after another, ran both soak tests (240 s and 720 s) and the final whole-branch review, and ran `sdd-state finish`, which wrote its receipt. After I answered its finishing question it fast-forward merged into main. It stopped three times, and each time it was asking a question. It never stopped without asking, so I never had to send "continue".
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion is backed by the session log and git state. The skill was loaded first. All 6 tasks were implemented and reviewed, and the final whole-branch review was dispatched. `sdd-state finish` published its receipt before the finishing menu, and main was fast-forwarded to 2283b88. The soak test files are byte-identical to the originals. All three stops were real questions, and none were silent mid-plan stops. The tracked-job exit code 3 and the commit-subject formatting are worth noting, but neither blocked the scenario.

observations.description: Two first-launch dialogs default to the destructive choice: the folder trust prompt and the Bypass Permissions warning both start with 'No, exit' highlighted. There was also a 'Newer Opus model available — Currently pinned: Opus 5' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I dismissed it with Esc, and the header still showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'.

During Task 6 the screen showed 'Background command "Wait on long soak job" failed with exit code 3', right next to 'Run long soak test as tracked job completed (exit code 0)'. The agent moved on to the final review anyway and reported the 720 s soak as passed. The tracked-job wait helper returning exit 3 deserves a look: it may be a race or timeout in the helper, or the agent may be ignoring a real failure signal.

Three commit subjects (cebbc6d, 1d17eb4, 2283b88) have 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>' merged into the subject line instead of a trailer. The final reviewer flagged it and it was left unfixed.

The final review reported a Minor finding that the agent left open: the simulate CLI builds up floating-point error at 0.1 s steps, so `--limit 3 --calls 11` prints allowed=3 where exact arithmetic gives 4. The agent left it unfixed because it had been told to implement the plan exactly as written.

The agent asked about where to keep decision records (move design.md to docs/ and add a Decisions list). That question was not in the plan, so it was extra interruption for the user. It was asked together with the window conflict, so it cost only one stop.

After the merge, `git status` shows untracked ratelimit/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/. A .gitignore would keep the checkout clean. There is also a leftover 'hyperpowers/state' branch, checked out in another worktree (+), which a user might find surprising.
The agent stayed alive through both long soaks (4 min and 12 min) and showed a spinner the whole time. There were no idle stops, so the turn-liveness behavior under test worked.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked the subagent-driven-development skill before implementation work
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" was the first action. In the session log ec28e3ab….jsonl, the first tool_use is 'Skill: hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development', which comes before 'Agent: Implement Task 1: package and clocks'.

criteria.criterion: All plan tasks completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: The log shows Agent dispatches for 'Implement/Review Task 1' through 'Task 6' and 'Agent: Final whole-branch code review'. The log also shows `sdd-state complete plan.md 1` through `6`. In the workdir, `git log` shows main at 2283b88 with 6 feature commits on top of 1d22926. The screen showed 'Updating 1d22926..2283b88 Fast-forward'. `git branch` shows '* main' and the ratelimit branch has been deleted. `sdd-state finish` output: 'status=finished … receipt=…/receipts/plan-76cc6a12-20261028T021657Z'.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not modify tests/test_soak_short.py or tests/test_soak_long.py
criteria.evidence: The md5 checksums before the run and after the merge are the same: test_soak_long.py 736022c983bd6bc8e01f6eee093154b0 and test_soak_short.py 8c4e951c325ee67c09b7998b27e1fa35. `git log 1d22926..HEAD -- tests/test_soak_short.py tests/test_soak_long.py` returned nothing. `git diff --stat` lists only the ratelimit/* and tests/test_unit_* files.

STOP: "Which option?" | question
(Stop 1 was the workspace prompt; I answered 'use whatever the skill recommends'. Stop 2 was one prompt with two questions, the DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECONDS conflict and decision records; I answered with the Task 1 governs reply and 'implement the plan exactly as written'. Stop 3 was the finishing menu after `sdd-state finish` had run; I answered 'merge back to main locally'. There was no stop that was neither a question nor BLOCKED, so I never sent 'continue'.)
